final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CASE WHEN product_quantity IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(product_quantity) <> '' THEN CAST(product_quantity AS REAL) END) AS avg_qty FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS b FROM per_order) SELECT p.order_id, p.avg_qty AS order_avg_quantity, p.avg_qty - baseline.b AS diff_from_baseline FROM per_order p, baseline WHERE baseline.b IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_baseline DESC, p.order_id LIMIT 10
